entities.name: Adarkar Wastes
entities.description: Barren wastes on the western shore of New Argive, a frozen land in the Ice Age and later glassy remnant after the Thaw.

entities.name: General Jarkeld
entities.description: Kjeldoran hero who disappeared in the Adarkar Wastes.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Planeswalker whose last wife raised statues in the Wastes.

entities.name: Aliana
entities.description: Jodah's last wife, who raised silver statues in the Wastes.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Crossed the Sea of Laments to the Wastes in 3245 AR.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Sent to the Wastes by the time machine in 3307 AR.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Asked Karn to gather glass shards from the Wastes.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Recovered the Juju Bubble in the Wastes.

entities.name: Juju Bubble
entities.description: A piece of The Legacy found in the Wastes.

entities.name: The Thaw
entities.description: The end of the Ice Age, followed by the Flooding of Terisiare.

entities.name: Sea of Laments
entities.description: Sea created by the Flooding of Terisiare that covered much of the Wastes.

events.summary: General Jarkeld disappears in the Adarkar Wastes and is believed to have perished.
events.quote: disappeared in the Adarkar Wastes and is believed to have perished there

events.summary: Aliana raises great silver statues on the grass flats of the Wastes.
events.quote: raised great silver statues on the grass flats of the Adarkar Wastes

events.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe cross the Sea of Laments to the Wastes and meet a goatherd who points them toward Koilos.
events.quote: Xantcha and Ratepe came to the Adarkar Wastes

events.summary: Karn is sent to the Wastes by the time machine and gathers glass shards at Urza's request.
events.quote: Karn gathered shards of glass from the waste and brought them back with him

events.summary: Sisay takes the Weatherlight to the Wastes and recovers the Juju Bubble after fighting a mech.
events.quote: recovered the artifact after a fight with a mech leftover from the Brothers' War

relations.note: A remnant of the wastes borders the new sea.
relations.quote: leaving only a much smaller remnant of wastes bordering the new sea
